name: local_courseplanner_rules
description: Walkthrough for the Academic Timeline Rules page (local_courseplanner).

steps.title: Timeline rules
steps.content: Rules describe your semester dates: when the semester starts and ends, which days there is no class, day swaps, and any other notes. Once rules exist you can apply them to generate week labels and closed-day markers on the builder grid.

steps.title: Create a rule
steps.content:
Use this form when you want to add dates manually. At minimum you need a Semester start date and a Semester end date. Add as many No class rules as you need for holidays and closures, and use Day swap for days that follow a different weekday's schedule.

The create-new form appears after the existing rules list so you can review what's already there before adding more.

steps.title: Existing rules
steps.content:
All your rules appear here. Toggle any rule off to exclude it from the next Apply without deleting it. Delete removes it permanently.

This list is the source of truth for the semester dates that will be applied to the calendar.

steps.title: Apply rules to the calendar
steps.content:
Click Apply Rules to Calendar when you're ready. The grid will regenerate week labels, mark no-class days, and add day-swap annotations. Any manual edits you made to individual cells are preserved - only the auto-generated content is refreshed.

This action uses the current rules list.
